title: Том 1 — литературная вычитка, партия 8 (разделы 36–40)
policy: Russian prose editorial revision only. Preserve Arabic source, author arguments and polemical attributions, Quran and hadith quotations, paragraph and section IDs. Do not restore incomplete quotations from guesses.
